display.purpose: Hero headline, one short sentence per line; Anybody condensed to 72% width.

numeral.purpose: A single poster-sized figure such as the match price.

headline.purpose: The one statement heading each poster section.

statement.purpose: Proof set as a display sentence instead of stat tiles.

body.purpose: Section copy in ink at 80-85% opacity, max 46-56ch.

motion.name: split-ball-apart
motion.purpose: The signature entrance: the split ball's halves start joined and slide apart along the cut (to translate(+/-13px, +/-5px), rotate -4deg/3deg). Resting state is the split; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion and on still repeats.

components.name: Ticket CTA
components.description: The primary action: a notched ink ticket stub holding Google's standard sign-in button.
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: inline-block; background: #16161A; color: #F2F1EC; padding: 20px 28px; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle 11px at 0 50%, transparent 97%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 11px at 100% 50%, transparent 97%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; mask: radial-gradient(circle 11px at 0 50%, transparent 97%, #000) left / 51% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle 11px at 100% 50%, transparent 97%, #000) right / 51% 100% no-repeat; } .ds-ticket-label { margin: 0; font-family: 'Anybody Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 80%; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-google-btn { margin-top: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: #fff; color: #1F1F1F; border: 1px solid #747775; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Roboto', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.25px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-google-btn:hover { background: #F3F3F3; } .ds-google-btn:active { background: #E8E8E8; } .ds-google-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F2F1EC; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Secondary action such as 'I already play here'; underline turns Team Red on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; color: #16161A; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; transition: text-decoration-color 150ms; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: #D2231A; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #16161A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Payment Handle
components.description: Method and masked handle in a square 2px ink chip, set on the ochre money field.
components.css: .ds-money { background: #E8A317; padding: 24px; } .ds-handle { margin: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 2px solid #16161A; padding: 8px 12px; color: #16161A; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-handle-rule { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: #16161A; }

components.name: Team Panels
components.description: The split: two edge-to-edge square fields, Team Red then Ultramarine, paper text.
components.css: .ds-teams { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .ds-team { padding: 28px 24px; color: #F2F1EC; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-team-red { background: #D2231A; } .ds-team-blue { background: #1C2E91; } .ds-team h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Anybody Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 80%; } .ds-team ul { list-style: none; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-team li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-team li + li { border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 241, 236, 0.3); } .ds-team li span + span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.025em; }

components.name: Bibs
components.description: List spots as training bibs: taken in solid ink, waiting in outlined paper hung at a tilt.
components.css: .ds-bibs { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-end; background: #F2F1EC; padding: 16px; } .ds-bib { width: 48px; overflow: visible; } .ds-bib-tilt { transform: rotate(-6deg); } .ds-bib-taken { fill: #16161A; } .ds-bib-waiting { fill: #F2F1EC; stroke: #16161A; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-bib-num { font-family: 'Anybody Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 80%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-num-paper { fill: #F2F1EC; } .ds-num-ink { fill: #16161A; }

components.name: Payment Dots
components.description: Paid state per spot on the ochre field: filled ink circles for paid, open for unpaid.
components.css: .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; background: #E8A317; padding: 20px; } .ds-dot { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #16161A; } .ds-paid { background: #16161A; }

components.name: Poster Headline
components.description: Condensed display type with team colours and the tilted ochre money highlight.
components.css: .ds-display { margin: 0; background: #F2F1EC; color: #16161A; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Anybody Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 4rem; font-weight: 850; font-stretch: 72%; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-display > span { display: block; } .ds-paid-mark { display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); background: #E8A317; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-red { color: #D2231A; } .ds-blue { color: #1C2E91; }

narrative.overview:
Footbolski is printed, not rendered. Every surface is a poster from the Polish Poster School, set with discipline: flat screenprint fields of paper, ink and three pure inks, never blended, never glowing. One idea per poster, stated by one cut-paper image and one stretched headline, with the facts set in a sturdy grotesque underneath. The fair split is the brand's core picture: a football cut into a red half and a blue half.

Density is low and scale is loud. Headlines are set condensed and heavy so they fill the column like hand-lettered poster type; body copy stays calm and readable at 17px. Colour is semantic before it is decorative: red and blue are always the two teams, ochre is always money. Imagery is drawn in code as SVG cut paper (straight scissor snips, pieces cut away with masks rather than painted over), so there are no rasters, no photos, no gradients and no shadows anywhere in the world.

The previous look (dark pitch green, neon accent, glass surfaces, Space Grotesk and Inter) is an anti-reference for this system. The app surfaces outside the landing page still carry that old look and await migration to this system.
keyCharacteristics: Flat screenprint fields on paper; ink for everything structural.
Red and blue mean the two teams; ochre means money; nothing else takes them.
Condensed, heavy display type (Anybody, width 70-88%) over a sturdy grotesque (Schibsted Grotesk).
Cut-paper SVG imagery with slightly irregular, straight-snipped edges.
Square corners, solid ink rules, zero shadows.
One signature motion: the split ball's halves slide apart along the cut.

rules.name: The Two Teams Rule
rules.body: Red is Team A and blue is Team B, always as a pair, always in that order (red left or first). Never use either for errors, warnings, brand accent or decoration unrelated to the teams.

rules.name: The Money Is Ochre Rule
rules.body: Ochre marks money only: prices, paid state, payment handles. The primary CTA is ink precisely because it is not a payment.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a solid field. No gradients, no glass, no glow, no tinted overlays; lower emphasis comes from ink opacity on paper, not from new colours.

rules.name: The Stretch To Fill Rule
rules.body: Display type is condensed and heavy so it fills the width like lettering; never set Anybody at its normal width or a light weight.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Every count, price and score uses tabular figures so numbers hold still.

rules.name: The Borrowed Face Rule
rules.body: Roboto appears only inside Google's standard sign-in button, as Google's branding guidelines require. It is not part of this type system.

rules.name: The Nothing Floats Rule
rules.body: If an element needs separation, give it a different ink field or an ink rule. Never a shadow.

dos: Do set every surface on Poster Paper with ink text, and switch to paper text only on ink, Team Red or Ultramarine fields.
Do keep red and blue as the two teams and ochre as money, so a colour always tells the viewer which team or that money is involved.
Do draw imagery as code SVG cut paper: straight snips, pieces cut out with masks, slight irregularity, no rasters.
Do set display type in Anybody at 800-900 weight and 70-88% width, and facts in Schibsted Grotesk with tabular figures.
Do self-host every font through @fontsource with Latin Extended coverage.
Do label every invented name or lineup on a public surface as sample data.
Do keep tap targets at 48px or more and the 3px ink (or paper) focus outline on every control.
Do make any motion safe under `prefers-reduced-motion` by designing the resting state as the finished state.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, glow or blur; every field is flat ink.
Don't add box or text shadows, including hard offset shadows; separation comes from fields and ink rules.
Don't use ochre for a CTA, highlight or decoration that is not about money.
Don't use red or blue for errors, warnings or generic accent.
Don't round corners on posters, tickets, chips or panels.
Don't load fonts from the Google Fonts CDN, and don't add Roboto anywhere except inside Google's sign-in button.
Don't bring back the dark pitch ground, neon green accent, Space Grotesk or Inter.
Don't replace a proof sentence with a row of stat tiles, or the hero with a phone mockup and feature tiles.
